point.description: An element of the fixed carrier set under discussion.

greatest.description: Holds of a point that the greatest-element definition axiom characterises.

minimal.description: Holds of a point that the minimality definition axiom characterises.

least.description: Holds of a point that the least-element definition axiom characterises (rendered as 'is minimum'; 'least' is a reserved logical word for the renderer).

lists.description: The first point lists the second point; an arbitrary binary relation.

mentions.description: The first point mentions the second point; a second, independent binary relation.

lt.description: Strict order candidate: the first point is strictly below the second (rendered as 'precedes').

le.description: Order candidate: the first point is at most the second (rendered as 'ranks below', which here means 'is at most', NOT the strict order).

sim.description: Symmetrisation candidate of the order, characterised by a definition axiom (rendered as 'matches').

akin.description: An unconstrained binary relation used for the conjecture section.
